title: Prompt: Two mall/hotel skyscrapers in city encased in a plastic like clear barrier
content: I saw these two/ three buildings after escaping from the big two and looking back from the end of the street, this was the night before last (last night/morning was all panic dreams - they are the worst ones when lucid and hardest to break out of and wake up). Pictures are quite accurate and middle one even has a smaller third building encased in the same clear acrylic barrier which I didn’t even mention in the prompt but was there in the dream. Is this a new addition to the mall world main mall/hotel centre place?? I do remember having to go like, up? To get out of the buildings but am not sure. I don’t remember seeing it before. Also I hadn’t really seen the mall as two tall buildings until the other night but I have seen it mentioned in many other posts/comments.
